# Filter King

> > Filter King is a leading supplier of residential and commercial HVAC air filters, offering MERV-rated pleated filters, custom sizes, and industrial belts with subscription delivery services.

Filter King specializes in air filtration products for AC and furnace systems, serving both residential customers and B2B commercial clients. The company offers filters in various MERV ratings (MERV 8, 11, 13) with free shipping and bulk ordering options, plus industrial belts and accessories.

## Key Topics

- HVAC air filters
- MERV ratings (MERV 8, MERV 11, MERV 13)
- Pleated furnace filters
- AC filters and replacements
- 6-inch air filters
- Commercial and bulk filter orders
- B2B filter services
- Filter delivery subscriptions
- Microparticle Performance Rating (MPR)
- Filter Performance Rating (FPR)
- Aramid V-belts
- Custom filter sizes
- Air filtration efficiency
- Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value

## Air Filter Sizes and Products

- [Buy 6 Inch Air Filters for your AC or Furnace](https://filterking.com/air-filter-sizes/6-inch-air-filter): 6-inch AC/furnace filters with MERV ratings and free shipping
